text_block_list.text: What? My hobbies?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
As Мэдзиро МакКуин and I are returning
to the
academy after a day out, I
happen to bring up the
subject of
hobbies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a bit rude? Asking a lady to
reveal her
secrets?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Since you've chosen to cross this line, I
suppose it
only proves your genuine
interest in the matter.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. I will share with you, if
just a
little. Now, come with me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: She brings me along to...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Here we are. This isn't publicly known,
but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I... enjoy cinema.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин likes movies? Seems a
little
ordinary considering the family she
comes from.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But seeing as we've come all this way to
the
movie theater, it would be a shame
to simply
return to the academy now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Do you want to see a movie now?

text_block_list.text:
You mean together?! Uh, well, I
wouldn't mind,
but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
How does one appreciate a film with
someone
else?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I... just don't know what to do. For some
reason, I
feel nervous...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
S-since I can't seem to remain calm, I'll
let you
take the lead. I trust you'll do
well.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Now... which film should we watch?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
What should I choose? I think the movie
that will
make Мэдзиро МакКуин happy
is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Five-Hour Inferno! Now that is a film of epic proportions. Originally, it was only three and a half hours long, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The director's cut is said to have
lengthened the
runtime to a total of five
hours. Truly a
nightmarish film...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Very well then. With two of us watching
it
together, the nightmare won't be so
scary. Let's
go!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Phew. I felt like we were in there all day!
But, I
feel more resilient now for having
watched it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Was it hard to get through?

text_block_list.text:
No. After all, you were there with me to
exchange
glances and laughter!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Hehe, I suppose it is reassuring to have someone with me to share the experience.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: The Great Prison Escape! It's a suspense film about a man who uses ingenuity to break out of an inescapable prison.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Very well. We shall watch in anticipation
how the
prisoner manages to pull off this
great feat.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
My goodness! I never imagined the main

character would escape by becoming a

fifth-dimensional being!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
To be frank, the film's logic was utterly

incoherent to me, but I found it
insightful all the
same.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It was a surprisingly intellectual movie.
Mejiro
McQueen seems to have learned
a lot as a result.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After overcoming the five hours of hell,
Mejiro
McQueen seems to have boosted
her willpower!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I wonder how she came to like movies?
Feeling
curious, I decide to ask her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It was a... reactionary development.
From an early
age, I had been dedicated
to hobbies befitting a
Mejiro, such as
flower arrangement and tea
ceremony.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But later, I found myself wanting to
enjoy
something that would let me relax
and destress.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Um... This is a secret between you and
me, all
right?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: I understand. I won't tell a soul.

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Remember, a promise is a
promise.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Heh. Somehow, I feel as though I've
conveyed too
much.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Um... I wanted to tell you. The time we
spent
together today was, um...
enjoyable.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You are a little different from those in
the Mejiro
household.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
With the exception of my relatives,
everyone in
the Mejiro household tends
to have a line drawn
between themselves
and me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
From my chauffeur to my private tutor,
they're all
polite, yet somewhat
reserved.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But you aren't like them. You cross over
that line
without hesitation, and... I like
that.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Normally, I don't watch movies with the
helpers or
anyone I only have a work
relationship with. But,
I...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Wait, are you trying to say...

text_block_list.text:
N-never mind! What I said just now was a
bit
odd... It must be an aftereffect from
the theater.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Just... It was not a terrible experience.
Maybe,
next time...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
No, I will leave this conversation to
continue at
another opportunity. Have a
good night, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин leaves with a light
swish of her
tail. It feels like she has
opened up a little.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
